title: Baseline the Bicep templates against pinned checkov and resolve existing failures
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server, first compile deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep to ARM JSON with 'az bicep build --file deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep --stdout'. Then scan deploy/azure/bicep, meaning main.bicep, params_template.json and paramsWithAuthEnabled_template.json, with checkov 3.3.17 using frameworks bicep and arm. In the workspace, run the scan only through node .claude/scripts/toolchain/scan.mjs; never call a checkov binary directly. For each failed check, either fix the template (for example ingress, managed identity, secret handling or minimum TLS on the Container App) or add an inline '#checkov:skip=<CKV_ID>: <justification>' comment that a reviewer accepts. Record the resulting SARIF export as task evidence. This is a template-only change, not a deployment, so no deployment window or change freeze applies. Do not change containerImage or any parameter default that alters the running deployment without a separate change.
acceptanceCriteria: A checkov 3.3.17 SARIF export of deploy/azure/bicep (bicep and arm frameworks) exists as task evidence and reports zero failed checks that are not suppressed.
Every checkov:skip comment in deploy/azure/bicep names a CKV id and has a non-empty justification, and 'grep -rn "checkov:skip" deploy/azure/bicep' lists only reviewer-approved suppressions.
'az bicep build --file deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep' exits 0 after any template fixes.

verificationMethod.description: Review the attached checkov 3.3.17 SARIF export for deploy/azure/bicep and the pull request diff. Expected result: 0 unsuppressed failed results, each suppression carries a justification, and bicep build exits 0.

rootCause.description: The Bicep templates were added to the repo without ever being scanned, so no baseline of IaC misconfigurations exists. Without one, a new blocking gate would fail on existing issues.
